column2: Retain accession at twenty-five, twenty-nine years in Jerusalem and Abba daughter of Zacharias. The maternal name is preserved rather than harmonized with Kings.
Retain doing right according to all David his father did. The ancestral title is not converted into immediate biological parentage.
Retain establishment over the kingdom, first month, opening the Lord's doors and repairing them. No explicit first year is added where the selected wording only specifies the month.
Retain bringing priests and Levites and stationing them on the eastward side. The location is not expanded into a named street or courtyard.
Retain address to Levites, self-purification and purification of their fathers' God's house, followed by expulsion of uncleanness from the holy places. Ordinary your addresses people.
Retain our fathers' departure, evil, abandonment, face turned from the Lord's tent and turning backs. The bodily idiom is rendered naturally without converting tent to temple.
Retain closed sanctuary doors, extinguished lamps and both omitted offerings. The English construes holy as the place and God of Israel as recipient.
column3: The attachment of holy within the adjacent dative phrases remains open; the inherited holy-place interpretation is provisional.

column2: Retain emphatic divine anger, terror, disappearance and hissing, and the addressees' own sight. Do not collapse the three effects into generic disaster.
column3: Disappearance and hissing require further lexical and spoken-language review; inherited terms are not accepted final polish.

column2: Retain fathers struck by sword and sons, daughters and wives captive in a land not theirs, with the continuing even-now clause. The selected land phrase is not omitted.

Retain the present heart intention, covenant of Israel's God and future turning away of wrath from us. My is inferred from the king's speech because the Greek leaves the heart's possessor unexpressed.
column3: Covenant of the Lord and the implicit possessor remain provisional syntax decisions.

column2: Retain the command not to slacken, divine choosing, standing before Him, ministry repeated and incense. No my sons vocative is imported into the selected sentence.
Retain six named Levites with fathers under Kaath, Merari and Gedsoni. The repeated Azarias is not merged and Gedsoni remains a distinct inherited form.
Retain the two Elisaphan names and two Asaph names. The list continues from verse 12 without a fabricated fresh action.
Retain two names for Heman and two for Jeduthun, completing fourteen named Levites across the roster. Familiar English group names remain provisional equivalents of the selected Greek forms.
column3: Heman/Aiman and Jeduthun/Idithon name policy requires consistency review rather than silent local renaming.

column2: Retain gathering brethren and self-purification under the king's command through the Lord's ordinance to cleanse the house. Royal and divine authorizations remain distinct.
Retain priests entering inside, uncleanness taken to the courtyard and Levites receiving it for removal to the Kedron torrent outside. The two groups' roles and two-stage movement remain explicit.

Retain day one/new moon of month one, entry into the sanctuary on day eight, eight days of purification and completion on day sixteen. Do not replace the selected sanctuary entry with merely reaching its porch.
Retain report to Hezekiah of everything purified, burnt-offering altar and its articles, and presentation table and its articles. No bread noun is inserted into the table designation.

Retain all Ahaz-defiled articles, his reign and apostasy, preparation and purification, and their position before the altar. The relation to earlier destruction is not resolved by inventing replacement objects.
Retain early rising, gathering the city's rulers and ascent to the Lord's house. The city remains unnamed here rather than repeatedly supplied.

Retain seven each of calves, rams, lambs and male goats, sin/kingdom/holy places/Israel references, and instruction for Aaron's priestly sons to go up onto the altar. The selected movement verb is not silently replaced with offer them.
column3: The scope of for sin across the animal list and the altar movement remain ritual/syntax questions.

column2: Retain the three sacrifices and blood actions: calves and rams poured onto the altar, lambs' blood around it. The change in prepositional force remains visible.
Retain presentation of sin-goats before king and assembly and hands laid on them. The plural hand-layers are contextually those just named; no extra officiant is inserted.

Retain priestly sacrifice, blood at the altar, repeated propitiation and twice all Israel in the royal explanation. With their blood is an interpretive instrumental rendering of the selected accusative.
column3: The construction governing blood and terminology propitiation require specialist review; no theological mechanism is added.

column2: Retain cymbals, nablas, kinyras, David/Gad/Nathan and divine command mediated through prophets. Gad's relation to the king and Nathan's prophet title remain separate.
Retain Levites with David's instruments and priests with trumpets. The two instrumental roles are not collapsed into one ensemble label.

Retain Hezekiah's order, onset of offering and song together, and trumpets with David's instruments. Accompanied interprets the selected relational preposition without a separately expressed accompaniment verb.
Retain assembly worship, singers singing and trumpets sounding until completion of the offering. The concurrent activities and shared endpoint remain.
Retain completion, the king and everyone present bending and worshiping. Everyone present is the idiomatic sense of those found, not a new attendance claim.
Retain Hezekiah and rulers instructing praise with David's and Asaph the prophet's words, rejoicing and falling in worship. No particular psalm text is supplied.
Retain filled hands for the Lord, drawing near and bringing sacrifices and praise offerings, repeated fulfillment by the assembly and voluntary burnt offerings from eager hearts.
column3: Filled hands and the distinction between sacrifices and praise offerings remain provisional ritual terms.

column2: Retain 70 calves, 100 rams and 200 lambs, with all explicitly for burnt offering to the Lord. These are not combined with the next verse's separate consecrated total.
Retain 600 consecrated calves and 3,000 sheep. Animals supplies the contextual category without changing either count.

Retain few priests unable to skin the offerings, Levite help until work and priestly purification were complete, and greater Levite eagerness. The comparison is expressed rather than a generic shortage explanation.
Retain abundant burnt offering, fat, completion of the salvation offering, libations and the work set right. Do not delete completion merely to simplify the layered ritual phrase.
column3: The genitive chain and salvation-offering terminology need specialist review; this remains a provisional close rendering.

column2: Retain Hezekiah and all the people's joy because God prepared for the people and the matter happened suddenly. The people are beneficiaries in the selected dative, not an accusative object God prepared.
column3: What God prepared remains unexpressed; no extra prepared hearts or event noun is inserted.
